experiments.title: Source-aware reward-scale and hypervolume-reference calibration
experiments.notes: V1 failed closed on sparse Minecart returns. Source-aware v2 then passed using an independent fixed-pool LunarLander pilot and a deterministic versioned Minecart environment reference front. Both course protocols now contain frozen scales/reference points with hashed evidence; no final-test data was accessed.

experiments.title: Paired-seed controls and allocation-signal ablations
experiments.notes: Frozen as 150 paired jobs across two environments and five seeds. The 30-job primary PCQN block completed and its source audit passed, but Minecart returned zero ore in all 14,400 validation episodes. Non-test diagnosis localized a shared sparse-credit backbone failure. Matrix v1 is now permanently blocked by a post-validation executor gate and will not resume; the remaining 120 planned jobs and final test are prohibited, and no comparative claim has been promoted.

experiments.title: Minecart sparse-credit PCQN backbone qualification
experiments.notes: The predeclared validation-only Uniform-PCQN qualification completed on all three fresh seeds and failed its all-seeds gate. Seeds 20264001 and 20264002 had zero positive ore episodes at their selected checkpoints; seed 20264003 passed both ore floors with 28/160 positive episodes per objective. Across all ten checkpoints, positive ore behavior was absent or transient rather than reliably retained. This is backbone-qualification evidence only, promotes no allocation claim, and keeps Phase 4, matrix v1, and final test blocked.

experiments.title: Minecart prioritized-replay PCQN backbone qualification
experiments.notes: Executed after explicit user authorization on clean commit 25328e8. All three seeds completed 1,000,000 interactions and 995,001 updates each. Source audit passed 30 checkpoints; independent nominal-validation audit retained 4,800 episodes / 4,710,905 steps. All 30 checkpoints had zero ore in raw and discounted returns. All selected checkpoints were step 1M with 0/160 positive episodes and zero distinct positive values per ore objective; unchanged all-seeds qualification failed. Backbone-only evidence, not a course comparison. Completed-job training cost is 3M interactions plus at least 27,044 logged interactions from a preserved interrupted seed11 attempt; exact unflushed expenditure unknown. Stop current-scope remediation; v3/scope changes need supervisor approval. Matrix v1, checkpoint locking, revised course execution and final test remain blocked.
